# zerops_project_prometheus_config (Resource)

Authoritatively replaces all Prometheus custom service-discovery groups on the default primary core. Use only one owner per project. Destroy clears the groups but retains the SYSTEM user-data key. This configures discovery, not scrape availability. Multi-core projects whose primary instance cannot be identified are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerops_project_prometheus_config" "example" {
  project_id = zerops_project.example.id
  # This singleton replaces every custom discovery group on the primary core.
  # Destroy clears discovery; it does not delete the SYSTEM user-data key.
  configs = [{
    targets = ["127.0.0.1:9100"]
    labels  = { job = "node", environment = "sandbox" }
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configs` (Attributes List) Complete ordered discovery groups. An empty list clears discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configs))
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `core_service_id` (String) Discovered CORE stack identifier.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configs`

Required:

- `labels` (Map of String) Discovery labels; an empty map is allowed.
- `targets` (List of String) Ordered hostnames/IP addresses with optional port 1–65535; IPv6 with port uses brackets.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import recovers all discovery groups from the primary CORE SYSTEM user-data.
terraform import zerops_project_prometheus_config.example "$PROJECT_ID"
```
